description: React component for a file upload button that uploads files to Amazon S3 using presigned URLs. Supports multiple file uploads, progress indication, and success/error callbacks.

methods.name: FileUploadButton
methods.description: React functional component rendering an upload button. Handles file selection, uploads files to S3, manages progress state, and invokes callbacks on success/error.

methods.name: handleFileSelect
methods.description: Event handler triggered when files are selected. Uploads each file asynchronously to S3, updates progress, and handles errors.
